crossRefs.note: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

translations.web: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
translations.bsb: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
translations.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
translations.asv: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
